brief:
A Palestinian man, Mohammad Shamali, died Friday from injuries he sustained in an Israeli attack on a group of Palestinians in Gaza City's al-Daraj neighbourhood Thursday, the Wafa news agency reported. The strike hit the densely populated residential district, leaving Shamali among the wounded.

Shamali's death reflects the continuing toll of Israeli military operations across Gaza. The al-Daraj neighbourhood, located in the heart of Gaza City, has faced repeated strikes during the conflict. His death was among multiple casualties reported from military action in the territory during the period.

title: Palestinian man dies from wounds sustained in Gaza City strike
